description: This file defines the DauxHelper class which provides utility functions for managing theme configuration, path handling, file locating, URL slug generation, and other helper methods for the Daux documentation generator.

classes.name: DauxHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static helper methods for theme configuration, path normalization, file resolution, slug generation, and URL handling within the Daux documentation system.

methods.name: rebaseConfiguration
methods.description: Sets a new base URL for the configuration and updates theme and image paths accordingly.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Retrieves theme configuration details, merging theme JSON config with defaults and applying theme variants and substitutions.

methods.name: getCleanPath
methods.description: Removes '/./' and '/../' segments from a path, simplifying it without accessing the file system.

methods.name: getFilenames
methods.description: Generates possible file names for a content part, replacing extensions and removing sorting info.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Locates a file in the directory tree based on the request path segments, considering index files and URL slugs.

methods.name: slugBase
methods.description: Converts a string to its ASCII representation, removing unsupported characters for URL or slug creation.

methods.name: urlSlug
methods.description: Creates a URL-friendly slug from a string, replacing spaces and special characters.

methods.name: linkSlug
methods.description: Generates a URL-safe link slug, converting to lowercase and replacing non-alphanumeric characters.

methods.name: getRelativePath
methods.description: Calculates the relative filesystem path from one directory/file to another.

methods.name: isAbsolutePath
methods.description: Checks whether a path is absolute.

methods.name: getAbsolutePath
methods.description: Returns an absolute path given a relative or absolute input path.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Checks if a path is a directory or a file based on the type parameter.

methods.name: resolveInternalFile
methods.description: Resolves an internal link within the documentation to a file object, trying absolute and relative locations.

methods.name: isValidUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL is valid and not a fragment.

methods.name: isExternalUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL is external (starts with a scheme, protocol, or mailto).

methods.name: isDataUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL is a data image URL.
